stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Grandpa always kept an old pair of running shoes by the door.”?
options: The granddaughter saw her grandfather differently after that.
After the show, many people said she looked like a real queen.
His shoes looked almost the same, but they were one size larger.
His grandson looked at the shoes differently after that.
